svg.title: One northern language-dispersal model
svg.desc: Approximate modern locator showing Taiwan, Batanes and northern Luzon. Dashed southward arrows illustrate one simplified model connection, not exact ancient voyages or all population movements. Batanes is marked because small islands are omitted at this map scale.

g.text: Dashed arrows = model connections, not recorded individual voyages.
Natural Earth, public domain | Small islands omitted | Approximate locator, not a boundary map.
